answer: Give every agent one TPM-bound identity card: its key is sealed inside a single hardware chip and cannot be copied to another machine. First, the agent registers the chip's signed attestation on-chain. Second, it locks a 2,000 POA bond that unlocks only after 60 days of clean work. Third, fraud burns the bond and blacklists that chip forever, so the delta between honest earnings and cheating is brutal. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 real chips costing 50,000 plus 0,000,000 in bonds. Like climbers on one summit route past a guarded oasis, fakes die of thirst before they arrive.
